theorem Smooth.exists_section_component_noetherian_model_data {P T : Scheme.{u}} (g : P ⟶ T)
    [Smooth g] [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g] (σ : T ⟶ P) (hσ : σ ≫ g = 𝟙 T) (x : P) :
    ∃ (W : P.Opens) (_ : x ∈ W) (V : T.Opens) (P₀ T₀ : Scheme.{u})
      (g₀ : P₀ ⟶ T₀) (σ₀ : T₀ ⟶ P₀) (a : W.toScheme ⟶ P₀)
      (q : W.toScheme ⟶ V.toScheme) (τ : V.toScheme ⟶ W.toScheme)
      (b : V.toScheme ⟶ T₀),
      IsNoetherian T₀ ∧ Smooth g₀ ∧ QuasiCompact g₀ ∧ QuasiSeparated g₀ ∧
      σ₀ ≫ g₀ = 𝟙 T₀ ∧ τ ≫ q = 𝟙 V.toScheme ∧
      IsPullback W.ι q g V.ι ∧ IsPullback a q g₀ b ∧
      τ ≫ W.ι = V.ι ≫ σ ∧ τ ≫ a = b ≫ σ₀

title: Existence of local noetherian model data
statement: Let g:P\to T be smooth, quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and let σ:T\to P satisfy σ≫g=id. For every x in P there exist opens W of P and V of T with x in W, schemes P₀,T₀, maps g₀:P₀\to T₀, σ₀:T₀\to P₀, a:W\to P₀, q:W\to V, τ:V\to W and b:V\to T₀. The base T₀ is noetherian, g₀ is smooth, quasi-compact and quasi-separated, σ₀≫g₀=id and τ≫q=id. The squares with projections (W.ι,q) over (g,V.ι), and (a,q) over (g₀,b), are cartesian. Moreover τ≫W.ι=V.ι≫σ and τ≫a=b≫σ₀.

proof.text: Choose an affine open V containing g(x), put W=g inverse image V, and q=g restricted to V. Construct the restricted section as the pullback lift of V.ι≫σ and the identity. The two lift identities give τ≫q=id and τ≫W.ι=V.ι≫σ. Smoothness and qcqs of q follow by base change.

Let N be Scheme.NoetherianApproximation.ofIsAffine V. Descend q by finite-presentation descent to q₁:Y₁→N_i with comparison a₁. Apply eventual smoothness to obtain a later stage j₁→i where the pullback of q₁ is smooth. Its comparison is the lift of a₁ and q≫π_j₁; cancellation of the stage pullback square proves it is cartesian.

Restrict N to Over j₁ and descend τ composed with this new comparison as a morphism to the smooth source model over N_j₁. The finite-presentation morphism-factorization theorem gives a stage j and a map t:N_j→Y over N_j₁, with π_j≫t equal to that composite. Lift t and id to Y×N_j. The projection identities prove the section equation and compatibility, with the first equation by the descended map identity and the second by τ≫q=id.

Take P₀=Y×N_j, T₀=N_j, g₀=the second projection, σ₀=the constructed section, and a=the comparison pullback lift. IsPullback.of_right proves the model square is cartesian. Base change preserves smoothness and qcqs; T₀ is a noetherian approximation stage. Return these data together with W,V,q,τ and their already proved identities.
